personalization_settings_reference_photo.description: Opens account-owned reference photos for image generation.

personalization_settings_reference_photo.defaultMessage: Διαχειριστείτε τις φωτογραφίες που χρησιμοποιεί το ChatGPT για να δημιουργεί εικόνες σας.
personalization_settings_reference_photo.description: Explains the Reference photos personalization section.

personalization_settings_add_photo.description: Trailing label and accessibility value when no reference photos are saved.

personalization_settings_face_photo.description: Accessibility value when only a face reference photo is saved.

personalization_settings_full_body_photo.description: Accessibility value when only a full-length reference photo is saved.

personalization_settings_both_photos.description: Accessibility value when both reference photos are saved.

personalization_settings_save.description: Navigation action that saves staged personalization changes.

personalization_settings_enable_customiz.description: Toggle that enables or disables account personalization.

personalization_settings_personality.description: Settings row that selects ChatGPT's personality.

personalization_settings_fast_answers.description: Toggle allowing ChatGPT to provide fast answers.

personalization_settings_fast_answers_de.defaultMessage: Το ChatGPT μπορεί μερικές φορές να χρησιμοποιεί τις γενικές του γνώσεις για να δίνει γρήγορες, αναλυτικές απαντήσεις. Αυτές δεν είναι εξατομικευμένες και δεν χρησιμοποιούν τη μνήμη σας.
personalization_settings_fast_answers_de.description: Explains the Fast answers personalization setting.

personalization_settings_suggested_promp.defaultMessage: Το ChatGPT μπορεί να δημιουργεί προτάσεις αναζητώντας σε συνδεδεμένα plugin
personalization_settings_suggested_promp.description: Explains the suggested prompts personalization setting.

personalization_settings_advanced.description: Expandable section containing advanced personalization settings.

personalization_settings_library_search.description: Toggle controlling whether ChatGPT automatically searches the user's library.

personalization_settings_library_search_.defaultMessage: Να επιτρέπεται στο ChatGPT να αναζητά αυτόματα απαντήσεις στα αρχεία της Βιβλιοθήκης.
personalization_settings_library_search_.description: Explains the Library search personalization setting.

personalization_settings_error.description: Alert title for a failed personalization update.

personalization_settings_load_failed.defaultMessage: Δεν ήταν δυνατή η φόρτωση των προσαρμογών σας. Προσπαθήστε ξανά.
personalization_settings_load_failed.description: Error shown when loading Personalization customizations fails; Retry loads them again.

personalization_settings_unsaved_changes.description: Title shown before discarding staged personalization changes.

personalization_settings_unsaved_changes.description: Confirmation shown before leaving unsaved Personalization settings.

personalization_settings_pet_section_tit.description: Title for the Work-mode companion section in Personalization settings.

personalization_settings_pet_description.defaultMessage: Επιλέξτε τον κινούμενο σύντροφό σας για τη λειτουργία Work.

personalization_settings_select_pet.description: Action shown when opening the Work-mode companion picker from Personalization settings.
